rule.statement: The owner who has possession and control of the vehicle should be considered as the 'owner' of the vehicle for the purposes of Section 40 of the Forest Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: Having considered the foregoing, I hold that, for the purposes of Section 40 of the Forest Ordinance, the owner who has the possession and the control of the vehicle should be considered as the „owner‟ of the vehicle.
